profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Note: Please be aware that my professional identity is currently being used for fraudulent job applications. If you received an application involving my information, please reach out and I'm happy to confirm or deny.

positions.title: Internal Systems Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed an internal tool to streamline and automate a capital approval process using Python’s web framework Django.
•	Integrated tool to interact with JIRA and PeopleSoft financial services through REST and SOAP web service calls.
•	Utilized Amazon’s web services; Deployed server on EC2, managed file storage through S3, and stored database in an RDS instance.

positions.title: QA Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Maintained daily smoke tests of several websites.
•	Ensured delivery of quality products to customers by examining web pages across several browsers.

honors.title: First Place - Binghamton ACM Coding Competition
honors.description: Won first place in a coding competition where participants try to solve as many questions as fast as possible in two hours.
honors.issuer: Issued by Binghamton University's ACM Club · Dec 2014

projects.title: Binghamton Laundry Checker
